_about: The maker's specification for a watch reference, shown on the product page of a piece that is that reference (piece.reference). Text is Rolex's own catalogue wording, copied from an official Rolex retailer's page because rolex.com refuses automated requests. It describes the reference as made, not the condition or papers of S&L's particular watch. Only add a reference when S&L's own caption names it exactly; dial colours vary within a reference, so the dial is left to the photo.
